hardwareObservationDialog.title: Start the board program?
hardwareObservationDialog.message: The program of the board is stopped. To observe it, it has to run: it will start again from its initial state.

missing.title: Install the Studomate firmware?
missing.message: This board does not contain the Studomate firmware. Install it? The program currently on the board will be erased.

outdated.title: Update the Studomate firmware?
outdated.message: The firmware of the board is outdated. Update it? The program currently on the board will be erased.
